CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   B. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.

   D. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)

   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
